_: The miniature field session the loop rehearsal replays. Two dishes photographed twice each (four same-scene clusters), a weighed benchmark capture per dish, one refusal, one slimmed bundle, and one non-meal note. Committed as data rather than built inline so the scenario the guard chain is judged against is reviewable on its own.
_size: The design's sketch of this fixture says 'two synthetic notes'. Five distinct captures across two clusters is the evidence floor a draft must clear to REACH the weighed guard, so a two-note session could never demonstrate the demotion this rehearsal exists to assert; the session carries six annotated captures per dish instead.
_carbs: base_total_carbs_g is what the replay predicts with the food database as CoFID bakes it. The rehearsal's stub replay scales it by (current density / source density), so an overlay entry that lands genuinely moves the weighed before/after — the veto is measured, not asserted.
